title: Dispatcher: switch the running process
purpose: Show outgoing state save and incoming state restore within dispatch latency.
alt: Dispatcher가 P0 상태를 PCB0에 저장하고 PCB1에서 P1 상태를 복원해 실행을 전환하는 과정
requiredChecks: Sequence P0 executing→save state to PCB0→restore state from PCB1→P1 executing.
PCB identities matched to outgoing/incoming processes.
Dispatch latency bracket spans switching interval between P0 and P1 execution.
No claim context switching is productive user execution or I/O.
prompt: Create an ORIGINAL English raster technical figure for an IT reference blog. Opaque white background, navy highly readable type, restrained blue/teal/amber, flat design, generous margins. Exact data and labels only, no logos/copying textbook composition. Title 'Dispatcher: switch the running process'. Four vertical cards with down arrows: 'P0 executing'; 'Save P0 state into PCB0'; 'Restore P1 state from PCB1'; 'P1 executing'. Right bracket starts after P0 executing and ends before P1 executing, labelled 'Dispatch latency'. Footer 'The dispatcher resumes the process chosen by the scheduler'. P0/P1 execution blue, switching amber; exact PCB0/PCB1 labels. No timing or I/O.
